self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG will be increased by 10%. After the equipping character takes DMG, the aforementioned DMG Bonus is increased by 80% for 5s. This effect increase can have 5 stacks. The duration of each stack is counted independently. These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is not on the field. Each stack raises the 10% bonus by 80% of itself, i.e. +8pp per stack, so 5 stacks is +50% and not +90%: the states below are 0.1 x (1 + 0.8 x stacks). "0 stacks" is first so a leaderboard saved before the states existed (selectedState null resolves to the first state) keeps scoring the plain 10% it always had.
